extracted.name: Middle Eastern White Beans
extracted.description: These Middle Eastern white beans are simmered in a slow cooker with tomato, pimento sauce, garlic, onions lemon, cumin, and beef broth until tender.
ingredient_lines: 1.5 cups dried white kidney beans, soaked overnight
instruction_lines: Combine soaked beans, tomato paste, pimento sauce, garlic, onions, lemon juice, cumin, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a slow cooker crock. Mix together until beans are coated. Pour in beef broth and top off with enough water to completely cover bean mixture.
Cook on High until beans are tender and liquid is thickened, about 6 hours. It should not be soupy.
